description:
Blind-spot `2026-05-04-140839` flagged that
`_project/sqlglot-upstream/repros/repro_all.py:repro_1_duckdb_all_keyword`
exercises only `read="duckdb"`/`write="duckdb"` and reported PASS on
`sqlglot==30.6.0`. That conclusion drove a TODO to retire
`_restore_group_order_by_all_keyword` in
`benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py`.

The retirement was wrong. BenchBox's actual call shape at
`dialect_utils.translate_sql_query` is `read="postgres"` (after
netezza-postgres normalization) / `write="duckdb"`. On the same sqlglot
version that pair still emits `ORDER BY "ALL"`, which DuckDB rejects.
The post-fixup is still load-bearing.

The fix is twofold: (1) extend repro_1 to probe both call shapes
independently, (2) document a wrapper-call-shape convention in the
README so any future post-fixup retirement TODO is gated by the right
probe.

anti_patterns.why: both probes are valuable, and the comparison is the diagnostic. Add the cross-dialect probe alongside, don't replace.

anti_patterns.dont: widen this TODO into a full sqlglot upstream-test rewrite. The scope is the wrapper-call-shape coverage gap; broader harness redesign is out of scope.

preserves.behavior: Existing repro_2 / repro_3 / repro_5 / repro_6 still run and report PASS/FAIL accurately for their respective call shapes.
The PASS/FAIL summary at the bottom of `repro_all.py` continues to print one line per repro item.
`benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py:_restore_group_order_by_all_keyword` is NOT retired by this TODO -- the cross-dialect probe will confirm it still has a job.

verifications.description: Cross-dialect probe explicitly reports the workaround as still needed on sqlglot==30.6.0

verifications.command: uv run --with sqlglot -- python _project/sqlglot-upstream/repros/repro_all.py; echo exit=$?
verifications.description: Harness binary still parses (exits with 0 or 1, not crash)

work_units.notes:
Inside the repro, run two transpiles and print PASS/FAIL for each
independently:
  - read="duckdb",   write="duckdb",  identify=True
  - read="postgres", write="duckdb",  identify=True
Return PASS only if BOTH probes pass. The cross-dialect probe will
FAIL today on `sqlglot==30.6.0` -- that is the correct result and
the test is what would have caught the false retirement evidence
in 2026-05-04.

Add to `_project/sqlglot-upstream/README.md` "Run the harness"
section: "Any new repro for an item that lives in
`dialect_utils.translate_sql_query` MUST exercise both
`read=<target>, write=<target>` and `read='postgres',
write=<target>` -- the wrapper invokes SQLGlot across dialects,
and a single-dialect probe is not a valid retirement gate."
work_units.summary: Document the wrapper-call-shape convention in README

work_units.notes:
For each existing `repro_*` (currently 2, 3, 5, 6), confirm the
read/write pair the harness exercises matches the pair production
code uses at the post-fixup's call site. Widen any narrow probe;
document the audit verdict per item in the README.
work_units.summary: Audit the remaining repros for wrapper-call-shape coverage

work_units.notes:
Update `.claude/skills/code/SKILL.md` (or the BenchBox CLAUDE.md
review-protocol bindings) so that a /code review of any TODO
claiming to retire a `dialect_utils.translate_sql_query`
post-fixup based on a harness PASS must grep the helper's call
site and confirm the harness probe matches the wrapper's `read=`
argument at that call.
